parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Defaults to descending for metric columns and ascending for rank, name, nationality, sport and type.

parameters.name: megaOnly
parameters.description: Keep only leagues with at least one tracked athlete above 100M Instagram followers.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Defaults to ascending for name and sport, descending for trackedAthletes and igReach.

igReach.description: Sum of the Instagram followers of the league's tracked athletes. Not a deduplicated audience: a follower of two athletes is counted twice, and an athlete tracked in two leagues counts towards both.
